boundary.description: From the junction of Chorley Road and Elm Street, E along Chorley Road, Partington Lane (B5231), Worsley Road, Campbell Road, and by a beeline S to the W border of Eccles College and Folly Brook. Then W along the brook going across Rocky Lane, Worsley Golf Course and by a beeline near Clubhouse to the Bridgewater way (water line). W by the Bridgewater Way to M60 (junction 13) and N by M60 then E just past junction 15 and by a beeline N to the middle of Sindsley Road, then by a beeline SE to the junction of Moss Bank Road and Charles Street, including all of Ardens Close estate. Then by a beeline S to Mulgrave Street, Westminster Street, Cemetery Road to and E along the railway and by a beeline S to and along Elm Street to its junction with Chorley Road.
